name: zentra-workspace
description: Zentra Digital - Fullstack Website & Enterprise Portal ERP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
